title: Kindle_Road
lead_summary:
Kindle Road is a water route that connects Offshore Road, Mt. Ember, Knot Island and Brine Road (West of the Old Shipwreck).
The first time the player comes to Kindle Road, Corsolas block access to a portion of the beach. They can be scared away if the player has a Mareanie or Toxapex in their party.
After obtaining Dive, the player can help another trainer push the giant boulder blocking the North-East portion.
missable_warnings: NOTE: Contains actions that alter player Karma.

Battle Tower === On the eastern side of the map is a building containing the [[Battle Factory and Battle Tower]] where players can participate in battles to earn Battle Tokens, which they can trade for egg moves, items and TMs. [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Sevii Islands]]
